requirement.summary: Action 6: Update BirPreprocessShell (Support data migration and old task cleanup)
requirement.description:
Reference: Epic attachment bir_data_process_and_report_revamp_proposal.pdf — Action 6.

Scope:

- Migration status file (in_progress / completed); migrate historical data 1 calendar month per scheduled run.

- Migrate rpt_dyn_pos_bir_business_days → pos_bir_station_summaries; rpt_dyn_pos_bir_check_payments → pos_bir_check_payments; build monthly summaries.

- During migration: dual-write old + new; after completed: new tables only.

- Report list: automatically route the 6 summary reports to new rptdesign after migration completes.

- Remove HQ fill-missing-month/day; HQ scheduled preprocess = migration (if needed) + cleanup only.
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement: [Jira-68290] Update BirPreprocessShell (Support data migration and old task cleanup)
Description:
-      Add historical migration from old dynamic BIR tables to new standard tables, plus cleanup of legacy scheduled jobs (Epic HERO-68279 Action 6).
-      JSON status file tracks in_progress / completed and last migrated date for resume; missing status file starts migration on the next run.
-      Migrate one calendar month per scheduled run: rpt_dyn_pos_bir_business_days → pos_bir_station_summaries; rpt_dyn_pos_bir_check_payments → pos_bir_check_payments; build pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries for migrated months.
-      During in_progress: dual-write legacy and standard tables; when status is completed: standard tables only (ensure all historical months have monthly summaries before marking completed).
-      When migration completed, report list automatically routes six summary BIR reports to the new rptdesign (bir_ph, bir_sales_summary, bir_revenue_slip, bir_ph_by_running_number, bir_sfe_ph, bir_sfe_detail_ph).
-      After cutover, HQ scheduled preprocess no longer fills missing month/day; it runs migration (if still needed) and expired-data cleanup only. Local daily close generates day-to-day BIR data and syncs to HQ.
Configuration / Parameter:
-      No special UI configuration is required; migration is driven by BirPreprocessShell scheduled runs and the bir_migration.txt status file.
-      After cutover, BIR summary reports under Desktop Format use the new rptdesign automatically. Sample BIR report list:
-
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition.
Result / Sample:
-      Sample: after migration/on-demand infrastructure is in place, selecting a date range older than 3 months still creates on-demand Preset Parameters and one-time Scheduled Tasks (BirPreprocessShell) as shown below.
-      Open POS282 BIR Sales Summary Report and set Date type to “Specified as below” with a range older than the last 3 months (example: 2026-01-01 ~ 2026-03-31):
-
-      The report engine shows “Background generation required” and lists monthly segments for on-demand generation:
-
-      Click “Add to generation queue” to open the On-Demand Job form (report, date range, email interface, recipients, format):
-
-      After submit, the job is queued. The result page shows the created Preset Parameters id and Scheduled Task ids:
-
-      Preset Parameters listing shows the created on-demand preset (e.g. “On-demand POS282 2026-01-01 2026-03-31”):
-
-      Report Management > Scheduled Tasks lists the one-time BirPreprocessShell tasks for each month segment (BIR on-demand …):
-
-      HQ scheduled task after completed migration performs cleanup only (no fill-missing-month / fill-missing-day).

# POS0207 - Itemize Sales Summary Report

## Report Information

| Parameters Name | Description | Options | Default | Platform Setting/Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Date Type | Select the business day for the report (single-select). | Fields Name | Fields Description | Field Calculation | Platform Setting/Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Outlet Name | Show the specified outlet name. Note: shown only when a single outlet is selected; not shown when multiple or all outlets are selected. | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No |
| Outlet | Show the outlet name as the data group header (one section per outlet). | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No |
| Code | Show the item code. | - | - |
| Name | Show the item name. | - | - |

# CUS0285 - Slip Revenue Report (with Additional Average Data)

## Report Information
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Name | Slip Revenue Report (with Additional Average Data) |
| Code | CUS0285 |

## Parameters to Validate
| Parameters Name | Description | Options | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Date Type | (single-select) Defines the business day scope of the reported data. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Query Configuration: Maximum Query Days, Default: Empty, No Limit | Current Business Day, Last Business Day, Specified as Below | Current Business Day |
| Begin Date | Start of the specified business date range; enabled when Date Type = 'Specified as Below'. | - | - |
| End Date | End of the specified business date range; enabled when Date Type = 'Specified as Below'. | - | - |
| Shops | (multi-select) Shop(s) included in the report. Cash-hide display depends on Config by Location > Hide Cash Payment In Report: when configured for All Location or for selected shop(s), data is filtered per that configuration and parameter Hide Cash is ignored; otherwise report parameter Hide Cash is applied. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name, Default: No | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Outlets | (multi-select) Outlet(s) included in the report. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name, Default: No | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Meal Period | (multi-select) Meal period(s) included in the revenue breakdown. | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Breakdown Payment | (single-select) No displays Payment information for whole day only; Yes displays Payment information for each period and whole day. | Yes, No | No |
| Breakdown Discount | (single-select) No displays Discount information for whole day only; Yes displays Discount information for each period and whole day. | Yes, No | No |
| Report Format | (single-select) Summary displays whole day information; Detail displays each period and whole day information. | Summary, Detail | Detail |
| Display Figure | (single-select) Net displays item Net Sales (item Gross Sales - discount); Gross displays item Gross Sales. | Net, Gross | Net |
| Show Discount Section | (single-select) Yes displays discount information; No does not display it. | Yes, No | Yes |
| Show Grand Total | (single-select) Yes displays Discount and Payment Grand Total; No does not display Grand Total. Grand Total requires selecting more than one outlet. | Yes, No | No |
| Show Payment Info | (single-select) All displays total cover and check amount of payment type paid; #Checks displays total check amount; Cover displays total cover amount. | All, #Checks, Cover | All |
| Show Tax ID And Address | (single-select) Yes displays outlet address and Tax Invoice #; No does not display them. | Yes, No | No |
| Attributes Condition | (single-select) Logic applied between selected attribute keys: And satisfies all selected keys, Or satisfies any selected key. | And, Or | - |
| Attribute Key | (multi-select) Attribute key(s) used to filter the reported data. | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Hide Cash | (single-select) Invalid when Hide Cash is specified in Config By Location. Yes hides payment data whose payment type is Cash unless excluded users apply (Config by Location "Hide Cash Payment In Report" with Exclude By User Group); No displays all data. | Yes, No | No |
| Calculation Of Average Data | (single-select) Defines whether add-on SC and Tax are added into divisors of "# CHKS, $ AV", "# GSTS, $ AV", "Total # CHKS, $ AV" and "Total # GSTS, $ AV". After SC + Tax adds addonSC and addonTax; After SC Before Tax adds addonSC except Take Away check under period; Before SC + Tax adds none. | After SC + Tax, After SC Before Tax, Before SC + Tax | After SC + Tax |
| Department Level | (single-select) Main department displays data by main department and sub-department name shows main department name; Sub department displays data by sub department including sub and main department information. | Main Department, Sub Department | Main Department |

## Data Fields to Validate

### Header
| Fields Name | Fields Description | Field Calculation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shops | Shows specified shop name (not shown if all or multiple shops selected; shown when multiple outlets are under one shop). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name, Default: No | - |
| Report Title | Shows report title "Slip Revenue Report (with Additional Average Data)" | - |
| Date | Shows specified date. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Date Format, Default Date Format: CCYY-MM-DD; Time Format, Default Time Format: 24-hour clock | - |
| Attributes Condition | Displayed when attribute key selected; shows And or Or per selection | - |
| Attributes Key # | Displayed when attribute key selected; shows selected attribute keys | - |
| Outlets | Shows outlet name. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name, Default: No | - |
| Tax Invoice # | Shows outlet tax invoice number (sample shows empty) | - |
| Printed | Shows print date, time and operator last name + first name. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Date Format, Default Date Format: CCYY-MM-DD; Time Format, Default Time Format: 24-hour clock | - |

### Revenue by Period
| Fields Name | Fields Description | Field Calculation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Period | Shows meal period name; clicking the period jumps to Detail Check Listing By Period; deleted/nonexistent periods do not show | - |
| Department | Shows item department name ("test" shown if item department not set), affected by Department Level configuration. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Department Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit | - |
| Amount | Shows item Gross Sales total (Display Figure = Gross) or item Net Sales total (Display Figure = Net) for each department. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Dept. Total | Shows item Gross/Net Sales total for all departments. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | Sum across departments |
| Dine In Checks | Shows Dine In checks item Gross Sales total (Gross) or Net Sales total (Net). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| # CHKS, $ AV (Dine In) | Shows Dine In checks amount / No. of Checks, affected by Calculation Of Average Data. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | Dine In Check Amount / No. of Checks |
| # GSTS, $ AV (Dine In) | Shows Dine In checks amount / No. of Covers, affected by Calculation Of Average Data. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | Dine In Check Amount / No. of Covers |
| Take Away Checks | Shows Take Away checks item Gross/Net Sales total per Display Figure. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| # CHKS, $ AV (Take Away) | Shows Take Away checks amount / No. of Checks; not affected by Calculation Of Average Data. # CUS0168 - Employee Itemized Sales Report (with Category & Department)

## Report Information
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Name | Employee Itemized Sales Report (with Category & Department) |
| Code | CUS0168 |

## Parameters to Validate
| Parameters Name | Description | Options | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Date Type | (single-select) Select the business date scope of the report. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Query Configuration: Maximum Query Days, Default: Empty, No Limit | Current Business Day, Last Business Day, Specified As Below | Current Business Day |
| Shops | (multi-select) Select shop(s) to filter report data. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Outlets | (multi-select) Select outlet(s) to filter report data. | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Categories | (multi-select) Select item category/categories to filter report data. | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Departments | (multi-select) Select item department(s) to filter report data. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Department Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Employee | (multi-select) Select employee(s) to filter report data. | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Meal Period | (multi-select) Select meal period(s) to filter report data. | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Report Format | (single-select) Select summary view (operation employee summary data) or detail view (operation employee details with item breakdown). | Summary, Detail | Summary |

## Data Fields to Validate
| Fields Name | Fields Description | Field Calculation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Report Title | Show corresponding report title by selection [Date Type / Shops / Outlets]: shows report name 'Employee Itemized Sales Report (with Category & Department)'; shows shop name only if a single shop is selected; shows outlet name only if a single outlet is selected; shows target date for one day or target range date for a range. | - |
| Emp Number | Show user number. | - |
| Emp Name | Show user last and first name. | - |
| Code | Show item code. | - |
| Name | Show item name. | - |
| Discount | Show item discount, check discount and extra charge total within item. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Net Sales | Show item net sales: item sales amount after removing discount and extra charge. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | Net Sales = Item Sales Amount - Discount And Extra Charge |
| Qty | Show item quantity. | - |
| Total Sales | Show item sales amount. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Sub Total | Summarize Discount, Net Sales, Qty, Total Sales each column total by employee. | Sum of Discount / Net Sales / Qty / Total Sales per employee |
| Grand Total | Summarize Discount, Net Sales, Qty, Total Sales each column total for all employees. | Sum of Discount / Net Sales / Qty / Total Sales across all employees |
| ** END OF REPORT ** | Standard end-of-report marker. | - |
| Printed At | Show print date and time of the local server, format determined by the settings. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Date Format, Default Date Format: CCYY-MM-DD; Time Format, Default Time Format: 24-hour clock | - |
| Printed By | Show operator last name and first name. | - |
| P. | Show page number. | - |

## Requirements Traceability
| Fix Version | JIRA Ticket |
| --- | --- |
| - | HERO-14691 |
